text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Mejiro Dober is full of<n>joy, both
because she's managed to<n>control her shaking and
because her<n>body is overflowing with power.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having grown strong enough to push<n>past her fear,
Mejiro Dober is now<n>burning with excitement for
the<n>upcoming Shuka Sho!
